items.title: 网购买到像头发的野菜 一查竟是国家一级保护植物！
items.summary: 扬州一市民网购发菜疑为野生发菜报警，经鉴定为国家一级保护野生植物，警方提醒切勿购买。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160951558670.png
据央视新闻报道，近日江苏扬州一名市民网上下单购买发菜，收货后发现货品外观、质感与市面上常见的海发菜、人工仿制发菜差异明显，怀疑买到野生发菜，当即选择报警。经专业机构鉴定，这份形似黑发丝的货品，正是国家一级保护野生植物——发菜（发状念珠藻）。
发菜名字带“菜”，外形纤细乌黑，如同散落的头发，过去因谐音“发财”，常在宴席上出现。但它并非普通野菜，而是我国西北地区干旱荒漠地带特有的蓝细菌，也是荒漠生态系统中不可或缺的关键物种。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160952037831.png
监测显示，发菜可以和周边微生物形成生物结皮，牢牢固定地表流沙，抵抗风沙侵蚀，减少土地荒漠化；同时拥有强大的固氮能力，能够给贫瘠沙地补充养分。发菜覆盖度提升10%，周边草本植物生物多样性便可提升约20%。野生发菜生长速度极慢，过度采挖不仅会造成物种资源衰退，还会直接破坏草原地表结皮层，加剧风沙危害。
我国早在2000年就明令禁止采集、销售野生发菜，2001年将其升级为国家一级保护野生植物，2021版国家重点保护野生植物名录继续保留这一保护等级。非法采挖、收购、售卖野生发菜，均要承担法律责任。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160952134139.jpg
警方提醒，市面上合规售卖的多为海发菜等替代品，普通消费者网购土特产时要提高辨别意识，切勿购买野生发菜及其制品，一旦疑似接触野生保护物种，应当及时向有关部门反映。

items.title: 在大家拼命卷画面的时候，这款新游却决定“反着来”
items.summary: 能在这个卷到爆炸的时代做出不一样，这本身就已经很难得了

content.v: 对于一款游戏来说，好玩固然是最重要的，但在大多数时候，足够吸引人的美术，往往才是决定它能不能被更多人看见的那一环。
无论是刷游戏视频，还是在 Steam 商店找新游戏，你第一眼看到了什么，就已经在很大程度上决定了你愿不愿意多看一眼，甚至走进去玩玩。
而我注意到《愚者不灭》，也正是因为这个原因，在当下大家都恨不得让玩家分不清虚拟与现实的美术画风中，它的风格显得格外"不合群"。花上一段时间体验了游戏的 Demo 之后，我更是确信了这一点。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261016_qq_596_1/18994.jpg
首先就是我们的主角戴维。粗看他是个 3D 角色，可绕着他仔细看一圈之后你就会发现，贴着他身体边缘的线条和颜色没有老老实实待在模型上。手臂、脑袋、身体，你随处都可以看到溢到轮廓外的线条和颜色，当你为他安装上各种配件之后，这一变化就显得更加明显。
按照制作人小林裕幸在官方视频里的说法，这种看起来散乱的设计，正是他想要的，因为这会让人产生一种"摆在别的游戏旁边时，人一眼扫过去就会问一句，这是什么？"的冲动。
这话听起来像是在画饼，但上手之后你就会发现，整款游戏的美术其实都在围绕这一点来做取舍与展开。
首先，为了达成这种效果，游戏需要以"手绘的线条和颜色稍微溢出轮廓"作为美术的框架。这在前期的设定阶段并不难，因为它只需要画出来就够了。但到了游戏中，为了让角色模型经得起从任何角度的观看，建模与原画这两道工序之间的拉扯自然是必不可少的。
为此，他们针对线条的呈现方式、颜色溢出轮廓的量，还有阴影的处理这些最容易出问题的地方进行了单独的调整。这听起来轻描淡写，但实际上却并不容易。不少 3D 游戏的方向是让手绘的痕迹消失，画面越干净越好，而《愚者不灭》恰好反了过来，因为这种"手绘的痕迹"不仅是必须保住的东西，更是它打出美术特色的底牌。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261016_qq_596_1/37746.jpg
而游戏中的怪物走的也是这个思路。
尽管它们的底子依旧是蜥蜴人、吸血鬼、鹰身女妖这类玩家们一眼就认得出的老面孔，但想要设计出新意也不是那么简单的。如果你直接照搬刻板印象中的设计，那玩家就必然审美疲劳，而若是太超脱玩家认不出是什么的话，这底子也就失去了意义。
挑的这些形象本身也有讲究。既要一眼认出是什么，能凭直觉猜出它大概会怎么打。因为只有先给一个熟悉的起点，后面的"出乎预料"才有落差可言。所以游戏选择了一种十分讨巧的方式，那就是在这些老怪物身上拼装这个世界里的"OT（超科技）"机械部件，让它们的动作超出玩家的预想。
比如刻板印象中只能近战的蜥蜴人与骷髅就被装上了长枪短炮，能从远处投射强大的火力，而鹰身女妖的羽毛全都换成了机械羽毛，摇身一变成为了"轰炸机"，从空中攻击玩家。可以说，引入"OT"的设定不只是为了看起来酷炫，而是真能带来不一样的功能。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/origin_202610161022441813.gif
对于这种组合，小林裕幸的解释是，它不是装上机械变帅用的装饰，而要负责强化这只怪物原本的长处、补上它的短板，并且会直接连到它实际的攻击和玩法上。换句话说，同一只怪身上装了什么 OT，你在战场上就要面对什么样的一套招式。
另外，同一种怪物还会有强度分级。同一个种类的怪物，精英怪就是要比杂兵的机械化程度更高，所带来的外观上的威胁感也会更强更夸张。只需要远远看上一眼，你就能从其身上"零件"的多少来判断出自己是不是遇到硬骨头了。而在形态各异的怪物中，小林裕幸觉得最难做的还是吸血鬼。因为它的形象太经典，也太深入人心，留给团队的空间反而很窄，每一步都得拿捏。于是我们才最终看到了游戏中那浑身高科技的别样吸血鬼形象。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261016_qq_596_1/54216.jpg
而游戏中的场景也是如此。现代化的电缆、中世纪城堡、罗马城邦这些曾经真实存在过的文化、历史地点与符号都被扭曲与重塑，以一种不可能的方式彼此连接。根据小林裕幸自己的解释，他们想要描绘的，是一种在"某个地方见过，可这样的地方从没见过"的地方。玩家会认出某段街道、某种建筑轮廓，可整体看上去，这个空间又不属于任何一个真实的地方。
地下城的取材来自现实，目的却从来不是还原。所以开发团队把洞窟和都市塞进同一张地图，让建筑以现实中不可能的角度彼此相接。而玩家的体感也恰好卡在中间，某段街道、某个屋檐你认得出来，可把视线拉远，这片空间又不属于任何一个真实的地方。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261016_qq_596_1/66017.jpg
最后，美术的这套思路也延伸到了 UI 界面上。
初次打开游戏的时候，我总觉得这作的 UI 看起来有些奇怪。无论是小熊玩偶形态的计时器，漫画风格的角色与敌人图标，还是用刻度表来代替血条的设计，都让我在刚上手时适应了好一会儿。
但根据制作人小林裕幸自己的说法，他们想要的，不只是单纯把信息摆在玩家面前，而是从"主角戴维眼里，这个世界是什么样"的视角去表现。
将视角转换后，这种种设计也就变得合理了许多。从主角戴维那街头流行元素拉满的服饰，到升级时展现的小票收据，再到敌人出场时一定会带的搞怪涂鸦，与许多游戏 UI 追求的统一、专业不同，这里想要的，是一种拙劣甚至天真的感觉。因为它想要让你意识到，我们所看到的一切，都是主角眼中的世界。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261016_qq_596_1/86104.jpg
换句话说，界面本身也在参与塑造戴维这个人，而不只是给他配上一层皮。
所以，无论是在 3D 美术中加入手绘元素，让老怪物配上未知科技，还是在真实地点中加入幻想元素，这些元素单拿出来都不新鲜，但把它们搅拌、混合在一起之后，反而成为了《愚者不灭》独有的视觉风格，对于这种风格，官方将其称作"放克"美学。
对一款没有前作可依、也没有系列粉丝兜底的新作来说，这么做显然是需要冒一些风险的。但放在今天这个大多数作品仍在追求更写实、更工整美术的大环境下，《愚者不灭》的这种"不完美"，也恰恰是它最醒目的招牌。
这条路能不能被市场和玩家认可，现在还没有答案，但从这套美术的取舍里能看出来，这种所谓的“放克”美学并不是说说而已，而是从模型、怪物、场景这种底层框架开始的全新风格。
游戏将于 10 月 22 日正式发售，Demo目前可在 PS5 与 Steam 免费试玩， 点击即可前往游戏商店页 ，存档可以继承到正式版。如果你也厌倦了千篇一律的写实风格，想要体验不一样的美术，那么《愚者不灭》觉得值得你尝试一番。

items.title: 美国车能飞！特斯拉全新会飞的跑车亮相
items.summary: 特斯拉第二代 Roadster 正式亮相。

content.v: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，在今天（16 日）上午的特别活动中，特斯拉第二代 Roadster 正式亮相。
根据介绍，2008 年的 Roadster 只有一个目标：证明电动汽车可以速度飞快、外形性感、引人期待，而今天发布的第二代 Roadster，则展现了历史上的一个新时刻：最后几辆人类驾驶汽车之中的佼佼者。
目前，该车已在特斯拉官网开放预订，Performance 版本预订意向金为 33.2 万元。
飞行视频欣赏：
宣传片欣赏：
截图欣赏：

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160940119717.png
新车配备姿态控制推进器和车尾主推进器，不仅能像火箭一样离地升空，还能在空中翻滚。
特斯拉为新车开发了一套风扇吸附系统，通过风扇产生的吸力将车身压向路面。特斯拉称，这套系统能够大幅提高抓地力，让 Roadster 过弯时的横向加速度最高达到 2g。
特斯拉认为，Roadster 的过弯能力将强到令人觉得不可思议，仿佛违反了物理定律。公司还希望用新车打破赛道纪录。同时，Roadster 的研发目标就是突破现有跑车的性能极限。

items.title: 还能加肉鸽？弹球游戏已经进化成我看不懂的样子
items.summary: 如果你也喜欢弹球带来的物理碰撞、大数字反馈，以及不断升级的弹幕狂潮，不妨现在就去试试Demo。

content.v: 说起“玩过的第一款电脑游戏”，《三维弹球》肯定会是很多人的选择。作为Windows系统游戏全家桶的一员，不用宽带拨号，也不要求电脑配置，点开即玩，给不少玩家的童年带来了深深的震撼。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/1114.jpg
放学回家打开电脑，点开开始菜单，找到“游戏”文件夹，一套熟练的流程下来，你就能找到系统游戏真神之一《三维弹球》。只需要按两个方向键，操控弹板把球顶回去，一次次撞到版面上发光的灯和缓冲柱，计算好角度，还能顺着发射坡道吃一波大分，爽，太爽了，等我小了我还要这么玩！
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/1247.jpg
由于一些某些知名大公司为了节约成本，以及源代码等原因，《三维弹球》未能跟随着Win系统更新保留在游戏菜单之中，也渐渐淡出了大众视野。那么，有没有办法可以让大家重拾起来这份童年的快乐呢。
有的兄弟，有的！
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/1362.jpg
《星际弹球》（《Appulse》）受经典《三维弹球》的灵感启发，深度还原了弹珠台游戏的操作和手感，同时又创新地加入了俯视角肉鸽射击要素，让玩家沉浸在接踵而至的一场场激烈战斗之中。
在《星际弹球》里，玩家们依然需要像玩《三维弹球》那样操控弹板，让你的“战机”在台面上飞行，一边在各种墙体中来回撞击，一边收集得分点，这套操作没有上手门槛，加上碰撞效果和音效，让你秒回沉迷《三维弹球》的童年。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/1558.jpg
这款游戏不一样的地方在于，每隔一段时间，台面上会不断有敌舰成波来袭，朝着核心推进入侵，玩家们必须通过撞击或是手中的火力把它们清除，守护母舰。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/1631.jpg
随着一波波消灭敌人以及收集分数，玩家所操控的战机枪械和性能都会得到数次强化机会。除了基本的基础属性提高之外，玩家们还可以选择冲锋枪、霰弹枪、狙击枪这几种截然不同的强化方向，从而演变出多样的战斗风格。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/1733.jpg
你可以配合精准的弹板操作，与敌人贴近距离“爽喷”；也可以将战机控制在核心外围，享受大狙“颗秒”的快感。刷分，强化，消灭敌人，游戏节奏和爽感的平衡拿捏得恰到好处，直到战胜关卡Boss依然让人意犹未尽。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/1835.jpg
如果你觉得这是一款简单的缝合游戏，那就大错特错了。游戏将弹球台和俯视角射击的底层玩法巧妙地结合在了一起，并非只是单纯的将两种元素堆叠。
例如，有趣的枪械后坐力系统。眼睁睁看着弹球从两块弹板之间漏下去，相信玩过类似游戏的玩家都深谙这种无力感。但在《星际弹球》里，每次开火产生的后坐力都会把战机往反方向推，也就是说，弹球离开弹板之后你还能继续操控它的运动轨迹。想多拿几个得分点，想绕过去补掉那只敌舰，或者只是不想让它掉出台面，都可以靠精准的开火解决。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/11076.jpg
值得一提的是，强化系统里还专门有“增加后坐力”这一类的“增益”，没错，你很难想象一个射击游戏里后坐力变大会是个增益Buff。后坐力越大，也就代表着你可以更好地“调整弹道”，收集到更多分数，或者撞击到更多的敌机。原本只能听天由命的物理模拟，被改成了一个可以反复练、越练越顺手的操作小技巧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/11222.jpg
当然，限制和代价也是有的，这就不得不提到弹球和射击的另一处联动了。大部分时间里，换弹不能主动触发，而是要靠触碰弹板来补充弹药。这给了战机一点性能上的限制，也让它没有丢掉一款弹球游戏的灵魂。
由 Le Rado 开发、Raw Fury 发行的《星际弹球》，已正式定档 11 月 26 日登陆 Steam。目前，《星际弹球》的试玩版现在已经在 Steam 开放。从Demo试玩版本来看，局外成长模块“空间站”已经做得比较完整，后续的关卡同样也在计划中，每一关都将会是一块新的版面，能看出正式版还是值得期待的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_ghb_690_2/11480.jpg
如果你也喜欢弹球带来的物理碰撞、大数字反馈，以及不断升级的弹幕狂潮，不妨现在就去 试试Demo ，同时也别忘了添加愿望单，让我们一起星际猛冲！

items.title: 前AKB偶像内田真由美变中国媳妇！婚礼上粤语致辞
items.summary: 据HK01报道，前日本偶像女团AKB48成员、现经营烧肉店生意的“猜拳女王”内田真由美，早前于10月10日宣布结婚喜讯，其后证实丈夫为中…

content.v: 据HK01报道，前日本偶像女团AKB48成员、现经营烧肉店生意的“猜拳女王”内田真由美，早前于10月10日宣布结婚喜讯，其后证实丈夫为中国香港人。深深感受到粉丝热情与厚爱的内田真由美，近日开始积极在社交平台以粤语发文互动。最新公开的婚礼花絮更特意先以日文撰写，再于内文配上整段粤语翻译。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160937408025.jpg
据报道，内田真由美对本次婚礼筹划极为用心，除了盛装换上婚纱与晚礼服外，现场更吸引高达12位昔日AKB48队友专程到贺。婚礼上最令宾客惊喜的环节，莫过于内田真由美联同众姐妹登上舞台中央，手持麦克风现场唱跳当年凭猜拳大赛夺冠赢得的专属Center单曲主打歌《机会的顺序》（チャンスの順番），配合节奏起舞，将现场气氛推向最高峰。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160938098965.jpg
为表达对远道从香港赴日的男家亲友的尊重，婚礼场地内特别设置了多幅粤语语句告示。内田真由美也认真准备了粤语发言，席间手持麦克风亲口向在场亲友大声致谢：“好多谢大家嚟参加我哋婚礼！”随即引起全场热烈鼓掌与欢呼。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160938161973.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160938176097.jpg
事后她更感性地在贴文中写道：“能够同一直以来照顾我哋、对我哋来说好重要嘅人一齐度过咁幸福嘅时光，真系好开心。直到而家，我对大家嘅感激之情依然满满，大家送畀我哋嘅每一句温暖说话，都令我好感动。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160937347988.jpg

items.title: 《控制：共振》销量突破一百万份
items.summary: Remedy Entertainment 宣布《控制：共振》销量突破一百万份。本作于2026年9月24日在PS5、Xbox Series X|S 及 PC 发售，媒体评测及玩家口碑均颇为出彩。玩家可在本作中探索濒临超自然

content.v: 《控制：共振》自9月24日发售以来，销量已达100万份。按发售后达到百万销量所用时间计算，它超过《心灵杀手2》，被认为是Remedy Entertainment迄今销售速度最快的游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792099533_312542.jpg
作为对比，2019年推出的《控制》到2020年12月销量超过200万份；《心灵杀手2》于2023年10月下旬发售，到当年12月销量超过100万份。Remedy此前将《控制：共振》称为自己规模最大、最具雄心的游戏。因此本作制作预算可能更高。
发售前，《控制：共振》在各平台累计获得超过200万个愿望单。发售后，它成为Remedy在Steam上首发规模最大的作品，最高同时在线玩家数接近4.3万人。报道所列的媒体评价数据为83篇评测、Metascore 83分。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792099474_989235_jpg_r.jpg
《控制：共振》已登陆XSX/S、PS5和PC。GamingBolt在评测中给出9分，称赞游戏的视觉呈现、战斗和叙事，同时认为战斗开局较慢。游戏此前更新已加入“新游戏++”，并调整了游戏体验。最新更新预计于11月推出，届时将加入拍照模式。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Epic 游戏商城为玩家带来了最新的福利喜加一活动。即日起至10月22日晚间11时，玩家可领取总价102元的《Agent A - 伪装游戏》以及《Bad Cheese》。《Agent A - 伪装游戏》是一款密室逃脱谍战游戏。设定于 60 年代风格的世界，到处都是怀旧未来的精妙设置，各种暗处的小机关小配件，以及逻辑巧妙的谜题。但要小心…露比·拉鲁格并不是那么容易被抓到的！在这个离奇古怪的猫鼠游戏中，探索许多复杂难题的迷宫，让你不禁开始思考，自己到底是猫…还是老鼠 。
《Bad Cheese》是一款受 1920 年代动画诡异魅力启发的心理恐怖游戏。你将扮演一只小老鼠，在妈妈外出时，与不正常的爸爸一起在家度过周末。要乖乖表现，让爸爸开心。

items.title: 《困兽之国2》：撕裂之地静待你的到来

others.title: 《困兽之国2》正式公布，撕裂之地静待你的到来

content.v: https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1016/20261016090653-3665-56712.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
《困兽之国2》：撕裂之地静待你的到来
诸神已然挣脱束缚。探索迷雾揭开后显现的撕裂之地。全新世界待你探索，全新阵营可供加入。你将选择站在哪一方？
开发商 Just2D 与发行商 Deck13 Spotlight 荣幸公布 《困兽之国2》 ，也就是独立爆款作品《困兽之国》的续作。黑暗迷雾已然消散，是时候重返异世界。魔法重回德罗瓦大地，但一道危险的创伤留存至今…… 一道裂谷将国土一分为二，未知的威胁潜伏于深渊深处。
《困兽之国2》 无愧于续作之名，带来玩家期待的全部内容：开放世界规模略有扩充，细节水准保持一致；战斗系统得到优化与拓展；新增两大阵营；更多抉择将影响故事走向；还有全新的族群文化等待探索。同时延续系列核心设计理念：**无任务指引标记，拒绝冗余糟粕**。开发理念始终如一：每一项设计决策，都把玩家当作成熟的冒险者认真对待。
基于这套设计理念， 《困兽之国2》 的开发目标十分明确：发扬前作优点，修正尚存瑕疵，打造一款时隔多年依旧能被玩家铭记的作品，一部真正的经典。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1016/20261016090654-3870-47385.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
点击观看预告片： https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1x7pr6HEXs/
众神是自由的，但这世界并非如此。
《困兽之国》故事落幕之后，诸神重获自由。黑暗迷雾消散，一道裂谷撕裂大地。它不仅蜿蜒穿过干涸的土地，更盘踞在异世界住民的心中。暗影蛰伏于暗处，未知威胁正在酝酿。生者们，是否已经准备好迎接即将到来的一切？两大阵营，各自以一尊神祇为核心。加入何方，由你抉择：你会追随熊母，还是投身巨羊的麾下？
不同文化激烈碰撞，局势愈发紧张。你终将做出选择。你的抉择将重塑世界的走向，改变任务的结局，牵动整个故事的发展。
抉择终将引向无法回避的战斗。这无可避免：异世界虽摆脱了黑暗迷雾，依旧危机四伏，熟悉与全新的怪物游荡在荒野之中。广受好评的战斗系统经过优化与扩充，带来更多选择、风格迥异的独特战斗方式，以及经过反复打磨的机制。
《困兽之国2》正式公布，登陆 PC 与主机平台。本作延续前作的设计理念，并在各个维度对原有优势进行升级。这款备受期待的动作角色扮演游戏，后续更多详情将在未来数月陆续放出。

items.title: 复古 RPG《利维坦之巢》正式公布

others.title: 复古RPG《利维坦之巢》正式公布

content.v: https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1016/20261016090458-6886-70236.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
复古 RPG《利维坦之巢》正式公布
《利维坦之巢》是一款复古回合制角色扮演游戏，拥有精心手工绘制的像素世界
Deck13 Spotlight 荣幸公布《利维坦之巢》。这款复古 RPG 由 Nostalgic Realms 与 Whiskybarrel Studios 的优秀团队开发，两位独立开发者携手合作，打造这款承载他们梦想的作品，灵感直接源自《创世纪》、《光辉之池》以及早期《博德之门》系列等传世经典。
两名开发者，同一场追寻
过去数十年来，RPG 渐渐丢失了自身的内核。曾经，RPG 的真谛在于探索，书写属于你自己的冒险故事：沉浸在精彩的支线任务之中，组建冒险小队，体验设计均衡的回合制战斗。广阔世界任由你按自己的节奏探索，手工打造的地牢与城镇处处充满细节与生机。它让玩家在脑海中构建世界，而非一味堆砌浮夸的特效。游戏地图邀请你开辟属于自己的道路，而不是被任务标记推着完成清单式任务。
这正是 《利维坦之巢》 的核心追求。我们希望找回 RPG 曾经的魅力，找回那股在岁月中渐渐遗失的、难以言喻的魔力。游戏灵感源自《创世纪》《光辉之池》等传奇系列，并融合早期《博德之门》的特质。全部内容以惊艳的像素美术呈现，正如官方公布预告片中所展示的那样。快来欣赏这支精心制作的 首发预告 ！
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1016/20261016090459-3693-91039.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

items.title: 《赛博朋克2》总监：开发已经超越了我最初的构想
items.summary: 《赛博朋克2》游戏总监Gabe Amatangelo近日在CDPR官方博客中分享了续作的开发进展

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160901494507.png

据GameSpot报道，《赛博朋克2》游戏总监Gabe Amatangelo近日在CDPR官方博客中分享了续作的开发进展。他表示，随着越来越多开发者加入，这个项目正在从最初他个人的构想，演变为整个团队共同塑造的作品。“我一开始有《赛博朋克2》的想法，但随着我让更多人参与进来，它就在不断进化。当我授权团队和团队中的个人去贡献时，它就变成了别的东西——它是我引导的东西，但归根结底是团队心灵与灵魂的反映。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160901598887.png
Amatangelo还谈到了他对“赛博朋克”主题的理解，表示希望探索去人性化相关的议题。他补充说，电子游戏深刻影响了他的人生，“它们打开了我的思维，给了我动力和兴奋。我希望这一代和下一代玩家，也能继续感受到这种影响。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160902006665.png
目前《赛博朋克2》尚无发售时间表。CDPR正在推进多个大型项目，包括计划在六年内推出三部《巫师》新作。公司明确表示将避免重蹈《赛博朋克2077》首发灾难的覆辙。与此同时，《赛博朋克2077》目前状态良好，持续保持畅销，衍生动画《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季将于10月20日上线，派拉蒙也已宣布正在制作《赛博朋克2077》真人电影。

“孩子，千万别循着乐声走入黑夜。仙灵就是这样掳走人的！！”曾经只存在于孩童口中的童话，如今化为黑暗现实。今年 3 月，Datadyne LLC 出品、剧情饱满的像素 JRPG《精灵熔炉》，揭开了仙灵世界的面纱。 《精灵熔炉》之中，究竟有什么在等待着你？跟随菲奥拉与伙伴们踏上旅途，去破解一连串神秘失踪案件。探索以 19 世纪爱尔兰为灵感打造的奇幻世界，但务必当心：你的抉择，将会改写未来走向。你甚至有可能唤醒一股远古的威胁……

经典回合制战斗、地图探索与解谜玩法

items.title: 好评如潮的生存沙盒黑马，终于迎来了1.0正式版本
items.summary: 如今的结束EA测试的《雾锁王国》，无疑也是最适合新玩家入坑的版本!

content.v: 近年来，生存建造品类游戏日益火爆，让不少玩家切实感受了沙盒“上头”的乐趣：一副锤稿、一张合成台、几组材料就能让你平地起高楼，尽情发挥玩家想象力与创作力。
如今， 不少游戏也会在此基础上，再次融入更多差异化的游戏玩法，让玩家获得更多不同体验：如《幻兽帕鲁》的捉宠与养成，《英灵神殿》的硬核生存与战斗......这些作品都走出了一条独特的玩法路径。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/21261.jpg
而在这一批作品中，24年初发布的《雾锁王国》无疑也是一部黑马作品，游戏上线之初最高在线人数就到达了16万，在10万条玩家评论中至今仍保持着85%的好评率。
作为一款自由度更高的沙盒冒险游戏，《雾锁王国》融合了生存建造、开放世界、战斗探索等多种玩法，且制作组近两年在EA阶段也一直保持着较高的更新频率，不断优化游戏、扩充新内容，堪称良心又量大管饱。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/25146.jpg
10月15日，游戏里程碑式的1.0版本终于上线。作为期盼已久的正式版，《雾锁王国》本次更新又会给我们带来怎样的惊喜呢？
在正式聊《雾锁王国》1.0正式版本新增内容之前，我们不妨与新玩家一起，谈谈游戏如此好玩与上头的“基底”到底是什么？
作为一款十分强调的自由度与创造力的RPG作品，《雾锁王国》的玩法与内容体量其实都相当丰富。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/34297.jpg
游戏的剧情十分简单：王国因瘴气裹挟陷入危机，玩家作为最后希望的“火焰之子”，一次次深入迷雾探索失落文明与各种遗迹，途中完成任务与击败各种boss......
是不是听起来相当传统与王道套路？但《雾锁王国》的精髓之处，在于将在这一过程中的战斗、探索与建设等多个环节，赋予极高的自由度与玩家上限。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/51399.jpg
举个很简单的例子：当你遇到一个十分复杂的谜题，或是迟迟找不到钥匙的大门时，一般玩家会选择死磕或查找攻略；而我们《雾锁王国》玩家想得就更简单了：管你什么谜题机关，直接炸药与武器攻击开路逃课......
是的，游戏中的大多数物品都能自主破坏与建造，问就是《雾锁王国》的自由度：
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/53975.jpg
而当你意识到这一点时，游戏的性质也已发生改变。过去你想做但无法做到的事情，都可以在《雾锁王国》中用天马行空的创造力与方式进行尝试：比如给boss挖个坑位后直接站桩输出，又或者从敌人防线背后开洞潜入搞偷袭之类“场景杀”，都可以在游戏中轻松实现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/54882.jpg
当然，这一特性同样也被本作的建造系统完美适配，其优势也得以进一步放大。
由于本作最小建筑单位为体素，这意味着你可以像捏橡皮泥一样尽情摆弄你的建筑，大大提升了游戏建造的可玩性与操作上限。从垒起一堵高墙到亲手建造的城堡大厦，其中的几乎每一块砖都可以由你控制；再加上本作较为宽松的盘点物理判定条件，无论是建造生存营地，还是挖地堡、盖高楼甚至单纯整活等一系列设想完全可以实现。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/55922.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/76031.jpg
你甚至还可以在游戏中玩雕塑、搓手办
最后，《雾锁王国》还提供最多16名玩家的开放世界合作探索。从主支线的各种探索兴趣点，到不同区域的生物群系、浮空与地下场景冒险，都能带给玩家相当充实的游戏体验。
极高自由度的求生+战斗+制作+建造环节相互串联 ，也确实将玩家喜爱各种要素全拉满了！
《雾锁王国》1.0正式版本，既是一次对过去里程碑式的总结，同时也是游戏结束EA迈向全新阶段的开始。
在正式版本中，除了玩家体验的剧情将迎来一个阶段性的结局外，本次更新还将附带两个全新的生物群系：高空的浮空岛与地下的大型熔岩区域，这两者都是剧情终章的重要场地。通过解锁地下层的机关与完成各种任务，玩家可以由下至上传送到浮空岛继续探索。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/76635.jpg
当然，包括更新的两个全新区域在内，地图中也将增加更多全新的敌人种类。比如浮空岛出现的机械卫兵、全新的巨型蜘蛛、电蟹BOSS等等，之前雪山与水下区域的空洞礼堂也将得到补齐，带来更多的全新装备、武器套件等奖励。简单来说，《雾锁王国》1.0版本将会是一个真正意义上的开放世界，等着玩家亲自探索。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/90012.jpg
另一方面，除了探索与冒险环节，玩家在正式版的战斗体验同样得到了极大优化。根据之前不少玩家的反馈，如今法师与弓箭手玩法方向均得到了加强，前者甚至用“重做”来形容都不为过。
在正式版中，奥术系职业在各方面都得到了优化与玩法改进：新增9种全新法术，魔杖战斗方式重制并补充了更多机制内容，在战斗层次、连招配合方面均有着不小的提升，相必也能被玩家开发出更多的玩法流派来吧。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/15/origin_202610151726483021.gif
与之对应的还有本次技能天赋树的再次优化。老玩家应该知道，《雾锁王国》的职业系统其实相当自由，不同的职业搭配完全可以玩出1+1>2的效果。比如你完全可以“魔武双修”，手拿魔杖身穿战士装备的同时，点出相关技能点兼具远近程攻击，这也算是某种BD构筑了。
1.0版本在此基础上，进一步提高等级上限的同时，也新增了不少全新技能供以玩家搭配组合。如今，伴随着技能树位置调整、技能点需求降低等一系列优化，玩家在游戏早期的战斗体验也将更加流畅！
当然，还有锁定优化、动作改进、装备与敌人变种增加等等诸多改进，还是交由玩家在《雾锁王国》正式版中亲自探索吧。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261015_xy_707_1/94488.jpg
最后，就是对建筑党玩家狂喜、同时也是非常重量级的Sparkworks建造系统更新了。
简单来说，Sparkworks就像是其他游戏中的“电路”逻辑系统，能在不同物体之间相互联动，将动态效果加入建造环节。举个简单例子，当你拉下拉杆或踩上压力板传递某种信号时，相关建筑就能达到自动开灯或打开大门等效果。
从过往的经验来看，这类系统的特点一般也是“入门易、精通难”，其较高的上限随着玩家的不断挖掘，往往也能诞生出许多意想不到的效果：比如自动电梯啦、整活陷阱什么的，想必又一定会与本作的体素建造系统产生神奇的联动反应。
另外，玩家现在还可以利用此机制，自定义设置各种副本与关卡并分享到社区中，创作属于自己的作品。对于喜欢建造的玩家来说，这些类似社区共创与创意工坊的功能在锦上添花的同时，无异于极大拓展了《雾锁王国》玩法上限，也为之后的内容更新提供了更多方向。
可以预见的是，伴随着1.0正式版对游戏内容的整体补全，后续还会有更多全新的内容与玩法等着制作组与玩家共同挖掘，也不妨让我们拭目以待。
如今的结束EA测试的《雾锁王国》，无疑也是最适合新玩家入坑的版本，如果你也对超高自由的体素建造、量大管饱的冒险内容感兴趣，也可以点击游戏下方链接了解更多情况！

items.title: 《叫魂》电影式预告片全球首曝，执念化作心魔
items.summary: 电影化叙事第一人称心理恐怖游戏《叫魂》（JIAOHUN）电影式预告片全球首次公开。千禧年前夜的中国小镇里，一场关于因果与执念的审判即将开场。游戏预计 2027 年内发售，登陆 PC（Steam）与 PlayStation

content.v: 电影化叙事第一人称心理恐怖游戏《叫魂》（JIAOHUN）电影式预告片全球首次公开。千禧年前夜的中国小镇里，一场关于因果与执念的审判即将开场。游戏预计 2027 年内发售，登陆 PC（Steam）与 PlayStation 5 平台。
“终于，你还是来了。”
通往仙女镇的列车驶向地狱。这里没有仁慈，没有宽恕，只有刀山剑树与无尽的刑罚，只有绝望。
那个声音说可以帮你，你能相信祂吗？
https://image.gcores.com/f413d17dd0b3fa6d8e9f6e009c1c16e5-1265-710.jpeg
《叫魂》是一款电影化叙事第一人称心理恐怖游戏，采用虚幻5引擎开发，融合解谜与步行模拟，侧重氛围叙事与环境探索。故事发生在90年代的中国小镇“白水县仙女镇”：家家挂历停在千禧年前夜，“喜迎新世纪”的标语还没揭下。你回到了这里，直面这座小镇的终结之谜——当所欲所求逐渐将人推向极端，执念化作心魔，最终吞噬每一个人。
https://image.gcores.com/165b809949ec219ade664c8d81c2e7f6-1265-710.png
《叫魂》将于2027年登陆 PC（Steam）与 PlayStation 5 平台。现在即可将《叫魂》加入 Steam 愿望单，如需了解更多信息，敬请关注游戏官方社交媒体频道。
子时熄灯工作室是一支来自中国上海的年轻团队，“子时熄灯12AM BLACKOUT”的名称蕴含着成员致力于打造极致体验的期望，希望玩家能在夜晚关灯后的安静环境中沉浸感受团队创造的游戏世界。工作室的首部作品《叫魂》源自团队对中国大陆怀旧文化的喜爱，项目在历经筹备与打磨后，团队正式成立子时熄灯工作室并投入全职开发。

https://image.gcores.com/287705028b6eb72c384b0480494a8d81-1280-720.jpeg
六款新车
六款新车均可在游戏内的“品牌中心”（Brand Central）购买。购车需使用游戏内货币，货币可通过付费或游戏进度获得。
Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo
https://image.gcores.com/40e6a071f5f03107b4e382b5036a8a4f-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/390fa665cf2ff4a4ce6935f776464895-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/878970e8d3c6772d411c0da7872ad1c0-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/75a53c3d048fcea00a15e3ffd0c7bbd6-1268-714.jpeg
Xiaomi Vision Gran Turismo是一款以风为设计主题的电动超级跑车。车身采用镂空与导流设计，水滴形座舱嵌入其中，在车辆各处形成空气动力学通道。车尾的光环状尾灯是外观的视觉焦点，同时也是大型排气口。
该车采用“主动式尾流控制系统”和“吸附式追踪环”等技术。经过反复模拟测试，该车的风阻系数为0.29，下压力系数为-1.2，空气动力效率评级为4.1。SIE称，该车在电动超级跑车的低风阻与高下压力平衡上达到了新的高度。
小米汽车设计负责人李田原表示：“电动超级跑车必须回答一个根本问题：我们是要为直线加速追求极致低风阻，还是为征服弯道追求最大下压力？最佳解决方案就在于两者之间的完美平衡。”
《跑车浪漫旅》系列制作人山内一典对这一设计理念印象深刻。山内一典表示：“当我看到小米解决了低风阻与高下压力之间的矛盾时，我真的非常惊艳。”游戏中，玩家可在斯帕-弗朗科尔尚赛道参加Vision Gran Turismo奖杯赛，驾驶该车。
Ferrari F355 Berlinetta '94
https://image.gcores.com/55eeddd4e74f063c04be257118f820e1-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/7b2563775da9d0e116b09fd474199a2e-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/a396cd0787f5fc34e17285aeeee141a5-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/e5ac79a4ce126cd6e988b23381b0b78b-1268-714.jpeg
法拉利总部位于意大利马拉内罗，品牌标志为“跃马”。法拉利将赛车运动中积累的技术与热情注入量产车型，1994年推出的F355 Berlinetta延续了该品牌中置发动机跑车的血统。
F355 Berlinetta的车身由宾尼法利纳（Pininfarina）设计，兼顾曲线美感与功能性。与前代车型348的方正线条相比，F355在空气动力性能与视觉美感之间取得了更高水准的平衡。游戏中，玩家可在Sportsland SUGO赛道驾驶该车，感受其在流畅弯道和高低落差路段中的平衡性与灵敏反应。
Honda Civic Si Group A version '87
https://image.gcores.com/f343baf7ca894a30ab713e410aa1d782-1268-714.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/6beece327547271af8433fe5c02d8e73-1268-714.jpeg
Mugen Motul Civic在1987年全日本房车锦标赛中获得总冠军。该车是一辆Group A赛车，以1984年加入第三代思域阵容的双顶置凸轮轴车型Si为基础开发。游戏收录的Civic Si Group A版本即以这辆Mugen Motul Civic为原型。
Si是本田20年来首款搭载DOHC发动机的量产车，量产状态下即具备较高性能，适合参加Group A赛事。无限（Mugen）对该车做了进一步开发，在比赛中持续调整车辆平台，之后向私人车队供应零部件。游戏中，玩家可在新增的“周日杯”活动中驾驶该车。
Mazda RX-Vision GT3 Evo '26
马自达自1967年推出Cosmo Sport以来，持续打磨转子发动机技术。GT3 CONCEPT是一辆重现4转子发动机的赛车，延续了曾赢得勒芒24小时耐力赛的787B的精神，并结合了最新的创驰蓝天（SKYACTIV）技术。
该车在此基础上进一步强化，针对赛道竞技进行了升级。游戏中，玩家可在“世界巡回房车赛”活动中驾驶该车，通过调校和过弯练习缩短单圈时间。
Honda Step WGN Spada Premium Line '23
本田Step WGN于1996年首次推出，凭借宽敞的车内空间、方正的外形以及低地板、大尺寸滑门等实用设计，长期受到家庭用户欢迎。
车系中的Spada车型配备宽大坚固的前进气格栅，车身下部环绕镀铬饰条。Spada Premium Line在此基础上采用特殊的白金镀铬装饰，是车系中的顶级车型，面向日常通勤与长途出行。游戏中，玩家可在Scapes模式中为这款家用车拍摄照片。
Citroën 2 CV 6 Charleston '86
雪铁龙2 CV是法国国民车的代表作，1948年推出后持续生产了42年。该车设计极为简洁，被称为“有轮子的雨伞”。
2 CV的悬挂系统十分灵活，可在崎岖路面上行驶而不打破车上的鸡蛋。该车车内空间宽敞，适合长途旅行，价格亲民。多年来，2 CV的核心设计始终未变，坚持独特的设计理念，因此赢得了全球汽车爱好者的支持。游戏中，玩家可在Sportsland SUGO赛道以休闲节奏驾驶该车。
Spec IV更新的更多内容可在《跑车浪漫旅》官网gran-turismo.com查看。未购买《跑车浪漫旅7》的玩家可在PlayStation Store免费下载《My First GT》。
30周年限定版手柄
为纪念《跑车浪漫旅》系列诞生30周年，SIE推出DualSense无线控制器《跑车浪漫旅》限定版，向这一“真实驾驶模拟器”系列致敬。手柄设计灵感来自系列核心的工艺与工程技术，配有赛车条纹和赛车运动风格图形，前面板为碳纤维质感，融入了汽车设计与性能元素。
Polyphony Digital首席执行官山内一典表示：“三十年前，《跑车浪漫旅》诞生了，初衷是为了分享汽车的美丽与驾驶的乐趣。这款纪念控制器庆祝了我们共同走过的旅程，我衷心感谢每一位不断以热情激励我们的玩家。”
该手柄将在全球限量发售。建议零售价为84.99美元（约合人民币572元），实际售价以零售商为准。预购将于各地当地时间10月22日10:00起通过合作零售商开启，手柄将于12月10日起在全球陆续发售。

items.title: Steam全新成就系统来了 效仿PS 本体与DLC分开算
items.summary: Steam成就集合功能正式进入测试阶段

content.v: Valve宣布，Steam成就集合功能正式进入测试阶段，已在Steam客户端测试版中开放体验。该功能允许开发者将游戏内的相关成就分组为“成就集合”，玩家可分别查看每个集合的独立进度。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160831331086.png
成就集合分为两类：基础游戏成就集合包含所有玩家均可取得的成就，以蓝色进度条显示；DLC成就集合则追踪需购买DLC才能获取的成就，以紫色显示，且在玩家获得相关内容前不计入整体进度。解锁某个集合的全部成就后，个人资料会获得“集合已完成”奖杯，且日后新增成就不会影响已保留的全成就状态。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160829362056.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160839129986.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160834547864.png
同步更新的还有全新成就页面，提供总体进度摘要、各集合进度及详细成就信息。全局完成率数据现已整合至该页面，无需再跳转查看。搜索功能新增筛选条件，可按集合及解锁状态查找成就。

items.title: IGN仅6分 《街霸》真人电影拉了：春丽嘉米塑造薄弱
items.summary: 《街头霸王》评测

content.v: 《街头霸王》（Street Fighter）是2026年由Kitao Sakurai执导的真人版改编电影，改编自卡普空经典格斗游戏。影片集结春丽、古烈、维加、布兰卡、达尔锡姆、嘉米等众多游戏角色，试图以荒诞喜剧与高密度打斗还原游戏精神。
简评：
《街头霸王》是一部“蠢得可爱”的爆米花电影。演员阵容热情爆棚，配角各具喜感，肯与隆的兄弟情是少数情感支点，动作设计融合港片、动漫与80/90年代动作片风格，打起来确实过瘾。但剧本薄弱、角色动机模糊、闪回泛滥、女性角色处理失当，大量笑料堆砌导致动作场面反而被稀释。它像在擂台上一通乱拳，命中不少，落空更多。对游戏粉丝而言值得一笑，对普通观众则略显空洞。
IGN评分： 6
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160817585631.png
总评：
《街头霸王》从头到尾都洋溢着一股“精神力量”——不是游戏里那种，而是演员们拼命想把这场荒诞派对撑起来的感染力。导演Kitao Sakurai显然不打算讲一个正经故事，而是尽可能把游戏里的怪人、怪招、怪梗塞进银幕。开场动画风格的序章相当出色，迅速建立了隆与肯的师兄弟情谊与“波动之力”的概念。但之后，影片迅速滑入“角色太多、故事太薄”的泥潭。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160819146536.png

选角是最大亮点。 David Dastmalchian的M. Bison阴森中带着诡异的满足感，越接近力量越“享受”，演出了独裁者少见的神经质魅力。Cody Rhodes的古烈一登场就自带主题曲，全美式魅力与冷面笑匠的节奏感让人希望他戏份更多。Jason Momoa的布兰卡虽然只是客串，但CGI怪物的造型与“拼音版绿巨人”式说话方式令人过目难忘。Andrew Schulz的丹·飞龙则是最大惊喜——从吸血经纪人到真心兄弟，意外成为全片少数情感锚点。Eric Andre的疯狂主持人基本就是他自己，但确实好笑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160819229645.png

问题在于，这些精彩配角大多与主线无关。 春丽（Callina Liang）和嘉米（Mel Jarnson）作为游戏史上被过度性化的代表角色，影片既没有足够聪明的解构，也没有真正赋予她们独立弧光，只是让她们加入混战。肯作为双主角之一，动机始终模糊——他到底是为了证明自己、纪念师父、逃避娱乐生涯，还是拯救世界？剧本从未讲清，导致结局本该有的情感分量落空。隆的暗黑力量线同样处理得支离破碎，全靠反复闪回强行解释阿库玛（Roman Reigns 饰）的重要性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/16/small_202610160819308786.png
动作场面是影片的肾上腺素来源，但同样参差不齐。 隆与肯在酒店房间的早期对决是全片最佳——镜头精准追随招式，喜剧节奏与打斗设计浑然一体。但越到后面，动作越依赖VFX特效，笑料密集到来不及消化就切下一场。锦标赛作为后半段骨架几乎沦为背景板，真正的擂台对决少得可怜。1990年代背景也未能有效营造怀旧感，全靠几首年代感混乱的插曲硬撑。

items.title: 美国立法者称视频游戏购买租赁伪装成销售：“当你为游戏付费时，你应该拥有它”
items.summary: Representative Ritchie Torres will introduce a bill aimed at protecting videogame ownership, including for onl

content.v: US Representative Ritchie Torres, a Democrat from New York City, announced today that he will introduce the "Power To The Players Act."
If it becomes law, the bill will see the US Federal Trade Commission create regulations that protect our "ability to own and play" purchased games, according to Torres' office.

"When you pay for a game, you should own it," says Torres. "Consumers must have the right to own, the right to play, and the right to transfer the games they buy. A game that can be taken away the moment a company pulls the plug is not a purchase. It is a rental disguised as a sale."

The game ownership issue is longstanding on PC, which moved to digital distribution a couple decades ago, but has recently come to the foreground of public consciousness as the consoles also transition away from discs. Earlier this year, Sony announced that it will end physical disc production in 2028.

The related problem of online games being decommissioned before players are done with them has also received more attention in recent years. The Stop Killing Games campaign in particular has raised the issue's profile, arguing that basic offline functionality should be expected when online games are retired. Founder Ross Scott and organizer Moritz Katzner gained an audience with the European Parliament earlier this year .

As one of its prime examples of the problem, Stop Killing Games has pointed to The Crew, a Ubisoft racing game which went offline in 2024, preventing those who purchased it from continuing to play even the singleplayer campaign.

The aim of the Power To The Players Act is to establish and enforce a more genuine ownership of purchased games, as opposed to the revocable licenses we currently buy, and to require that offline modes be made available before online games are shut down.

For DRM-free games, such as those purchased from GOG, ownership is a non-issue: Once you have the game files, you can back them up and use them for as long as you can find a PC that'll run them. Realistically, the FTC is not going to mandate the eradication of software copy protection, so if passed the bill would presumably arrive at a softer definition of ownership.
I've reached out to Rep Torres' office for more information on what enforcement of the bill is expected to look like, should it pass.

content.v: Valve has pushed a new update to its Steam client beta introducing big changes to how achievements work and how they're displayed. Developers can now create sets of achievements customized to their game, like mastering a specific character class or finishing a singleplayer campaign. Sets also distinguish base game achievements from separate DLC and seasonal sets.

Previously if you unlocked all achievements for a game you'd see a nice 'n' tidy 100% in your achievements list. But if that game got DLC with new achievements, that 100% would drop accordingly. I can understand why achievement heads would be annoyed by this: what if you have no intention of playing the DLC, but want to retain 100% completion bragging rights? This update fixes that, assuming devs use it.

It's a similar situation for seasonal achievements, which I can see working well with battle passes. The example Valve uses is a set called "Halloween Event Achievements" which are valid for a certain period and don't affect the achievement count of the base game. In other words: if you have the completionist itch but skip a season, it won't affect your base game stats.

All these changes have prompted a refresh of the achievements page. Most achievements info is now displayed on a single page: your progress towards overall completion, and your progress towards unlocking individual achievements.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kCu8x6JbkvWFTB9BExWeHY-1920-80.png

I especially like that you can now directly compare achievements with up to three friends at once, which is what's being displayed at the bottom of the above image. This has been a feature on PlayStation consoles for a while, and so has separate sets for DLC achievements. It's nice that Valve has caught up.

items.title: “我只是有点断线”——杰夫·卡普兰不惜一切代价避免《守望先锋》
items.summary: Former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan explained how he protects his psyche by completely avoiding online discu

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/jeff-kaplan-avoids-reading-ovw-subreddits-1792107785773.jpg
Former Overwatch director Jeff Kaplan explained how he protects his psyche by completely avoiding online discussions and subreddits about Blizzard's hero shooter.

If you’re a die-hard Overwatch player, you’re likely familiar with the name Jeff Kaplan. He was essentially the face of the game for years, endearing fans with his regular developer updates and memorable interactions with its fanbase.

After leaving Blizzard in 2021 , Kaplan founded his own game development studio and is currently working on an open world, action-survival shooter called The Legend of California. He has firmly put Overwatch behind him — to the point where he avoids interacting with it at all costs online.
“With Overwatch, I had a very almost clinical separation, knowing how the WoW thing had gone,” Kaplan said in a recent interview with GameSpot . “I’ve literally not played the game since April 2021.

“I don’t, for my own psyche, I don’t read the subreddits. After I said my goodbye to competitive Overwatch and the Overwatch subreddit, I never go back and read. I don’t watch YouTube [videos]. I don’t search for my name in Overwatch. I don’t search for Overwatch. I sort of just disconnect. I actually tell all the algorithms like, ‘Yeah, I’m not really interested in Overwatch anymore. I know you think I’m the Overwatch guy, but like, that’s just not for me anymore.'”

He told the outlet that it was surprisingly more painful for him to leave the World of Warcraft team to work on Overwatch than it was to put the hero shooter in his rear view, calling it a “training moment” for taking the next step in his career.

“WoW was who I was at that point,” he explained. “I worked every minute, every waking minute, on WoW. If I wasn’t working on WoW, I was playing WoW. And every time I played WoW, I had this notepad next to the desk that I’d be filling out to walk in the next morning and go, ‘These are all the things we need to change.’ It was kind of shocking in a very negative emotional way to step away from WoW, because it was such a part of who I was and how I identified. It was who I was as a game developer.”
After learning the hard way that the games he worked on didn’t belong to him, but were instead an IP under Blizzard’s ownership, it was easier for him to move forward.

“Overwatch happened. I was a part of it. There’s a group there now, and Overwatch is now about them. Both the players and the developers, that’s their Overwatch now. They’re making it, they own it, they play it. I’m onto this new thing, and that’s where I’m at in my life,” he said.

Kaplan hasn’t shied away from sharing his thoughts on the current gaming industry since making his exit from Blizzard almost half a decade ago. Most recently, he had some harsh words for players who complain about games they’ll never actually play.
"If a game comes out, and you don't want to play it, and you've never played it? Shut the f*** up. No one cares,” he said.
And in March, he revealed the reason why he actually left Blizzard behind, describing a specific meeting that he called “the biggest f*** you moment I had in my career.”
Image Credits: James Sheppard/Edge Magazine/Future via Getty Images

items.title: 《Control Resonant》销量突破 100 万份，成为工作室销量最快的游戏后，Remedy 老板做出了反应
items.summary: Control Resonant has sold one million copies, becoming Remedy’s fastest-selling game in spite of leakers crack

others.title: Control Resonant 在 3 周内售出 100 万份，成为 Remedy 有史以来销售最快的游戏

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/10/controlthumb-1789054804916.png
Control Resonant has sold one million copies, becoming Remedy’s fastest-selling game in spite of leakers cracking the title and pirating it after its digital launch in September.
Remedy celebrated this milestone on October 15, writing on Twitter/X, “Thank you for the support. For playing, sharing, and being a part of the community.”
Remedy’s communications director Thomas Puha also commented on this achievement, saying, “There we go. Strong start.”
There we go. Strong start.

This means that Control Resonant has soared past Alan Wake 2 , which previously held the record for the studio’s fastest-selling title. The legacy sequel reached one million copies sold two months after its release; Control Resonant has achieved that figure in just three weeks.

This is welcome news for both Remedy and fans of the game, many of whom urged players against downloading the pirated version of the title when it launched digitally in late September. It seems this wasn’t a crippling setback for the developer, though, given its current financial success — and physical editions of the game have just now been released, so there’s still more profit to be had.

Control Resonant was met with critical acclaim among both reviewers and players alike. We at IGN scored it an eight out of 10 , with reviewer Michael Higham saying, “Even when combat's sharp edge eventually dulls, Control Resonant is a great addition to the Remedyverse. While its story follows a more standard framework, its gravitational pull is in the inventive world built around it and the humanization that grounds the paranatural intrigue.”
In fact, the game was so good that many internet pirates decided against illegally downloading it, choosing instead to support Remedy in the hopes that its success would help keep the studio alive.

"One of the very few games I'm going to be buying, Remedy are on the brink of bankruptcy, this is their make or break title, I love their games and gotta do what I can to keep them afloat," wrote one fan on a piracy subreddit.
"I wasn't planning to buy it but now I feel like I should," another said. "I like Remedy. They do good games."

Remedy is known for titles like the original Control game, Alan Wake 2, Max Payne , and Quantum Break . And while their offerings have been met with high praise from players, they aren’t necessarily tailored for mass appeal, leaving some gamers worried about the developer’s future — but if these latest figures are anything to go by, it seems to be faring just fine.

content.v: 前Valve编剧Chet Faliszek质疑Epic游戏商城启动器的改版公告，认为新版虽然强调速度和界面变化，却没有讲清社区功能将如何发展。Epic Games称，新版启动器比现有版本加载更快、响应更灵敏，外观也有所更新，但首个版本的功能较少。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792103125_859341_jpg_r.jpg
Faliszek在回应视频中说，公告的措辞一度让他难以相信。在他看来，玩家能直接感受到的明确变化主要是新界面；仅凭速度提升，还不足以说明新版启动器为何值得期待。
他还特别提到公告用“快艇而非游艇”形容首版产品。Faliszek认为，这可能是在影射Valve联合创始人Gabe Newell的游艇，并将其解读为Epic首席执行官Tim Sweeney对竞争对手的挖苦。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792103125_292254_jpg_r.jpg
谈到商店体验，Faliszek认为，Steam通过内容发现、奖励、动态和个人表达形成了社区生态，而Epic游戏商城在他眼中仍显得冷清。他承认Steam的评论和论坛也有改进空间，但认为Epic尚未清楚交代启动器的长期方向，改版公告也没有回答社区功能接下来如何发展。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 美国众议员Ritchie Torres计划提出联邦法案，保障消费者购买数字游戏后的使用权益。按他的构想，带有在线功能的游戏在服务器最终关闭后，仍须保留可运行的离线模式。这项法案目前尚未正式进入国会程序。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792103013_995919_jpg_r.jpg
这项拟议法案名为《Power To The Players Act》。Torres主张，消费者付款购买游戏后，应能够拥有、游玩并转让该游戏。他希望由美国联邦贸易委员会制定规则，要求数字游戏销售公司给予玩家比随时可能失效的许可更充分的权益。
《NBA 2K25》的停服安排被用来说明这一问题：该游戏计划于10月30日从数字商店下架，在线服务器将于2027年1月1日关闭，届时部分受欢迎的模式将无法继续游玩。Torres认为，玩家已在游戏上投入金钱和时间，停服不应让已购内容失去基本使用价值。倡导组织Stop Killing Games此前也提出过类似诉求。
Torres尚未确认是否已有共同提案人或跨党派支持。法案的最终条文、审议结果和执行方式仍未确定。

content.v: 《GTA6》开启预购后，G2A平台上的该作商品页访问量增至此前的65倍。G2A销售合作与新业务负责人Katarzyna Jakubiec表示，预售期间平台的PlayStation礼品卡购买量创下纪录，此后仍持续增长。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792102210_573971_jpg_r.jpg
Jakubiec还表示，《GTA6》成为G2A在包括英国、美国在内的45个国家最受关注的商品，并在46个国家进入平台关注榜前十。这些数字反映的是G2A平台上的访问、关注和礼品卡购买情况，不能直接视为游戏销量。
为应对需求变化，G2A进行了多次用户调查。Jakubiec称，略多于半数受访者计划在游戏发售后24小时内开始游玩，也有人打算稍后购买。平台因此计划关注发售后的多轮购买需求，而不只准备发售当天的访问高峰。
G2A提供游戏兑换码、充值额度等商品，用户可以比较不同卖家的报价。目前，该平台披露的是预购阶段的访问与购买数据；游戏最终销量和发售时的网络负载仍未确定。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《守望先锋》副游戏总监Alec Dawson表示，团队没有可复制的长期运营秘诀，需要减少对试验的顾虑，在日常开发中持续作出好的决定。游戏总监Aaron Keller认为，玩家希望看到新内容和变化，但这些变化应发生在竞技框架之内。

items.title: 职业 Dota 2 选手声称他必须在警察面前打满整场比赛才能证明自己的身份
items.summary: A pro Dota 2 player is claiming he had to play a full Dota match in front of police officers to prove his iden

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/kez-1792100791294.jpg
A pro Dota 2 player is claiming that he had to play a full Dota match in front of police officers to prove his identity.

According to Nuengnara "23savage" Teeramahanon, who currently plays hard carry for Xipto eSports, the team’s boot camp in Kuala Lumpur was raided by police earlier this week. In a post to Facebook on Tuesday, 23savage describes the police placing the team in handcuffs and confiscating their belongings.

The officers proceeded to interrogate the players about why they were in the city and whether they were really pro players. According to 23savage, one of the officers was familiar with Dota, and was willing to scroll the player’s Instagram for proof of his pro career.

A photo 23savage had recently posted of himself and popular Malaysian influencer Ms. Puiyi was, according to the post, somewhat acceptable evidence. Enough evidence, in fact, for the police officers to remove his handcuffs and test what really mattered: how good he is at defending the ancients.

23savage proceeded to start up a Dota match right in front of the police officers, dropping 32 kills as the hard carry Kez. The Dota player alleges that this was enough proof to convince the officers to let the team go, and also that they stole two jars of Nutella on their way out.

Commenters on the post quickly doubted 23savage’s claims, presuming the post to be a joke, but 23savage has been actively defending his story in the replies. Reddit users continue to doubt the hard carry player, while others jokingly claim 23savage’s story is saving Valve’s MOBA.

The incident doesn’t seem to have had much impact on Xipto, who have been climbing the ranks of SEA Dota. The team recently won the EPL SEA tournament without losing a single series, achieving an impressive 10-match win streak. The team’s full roster currently consists of 23savage (Carry), inYourdreaM (Mid), Fbz (Offlane), Q (Support), and Oli (Support), who are now competing for a spot in the DreamLeague Season 30 tournament .

Dota 2 itself has been seeing some notable player gains in 2026, having recently hit its peak player count since 2022 . The game continues to receive occasional patches and content updates, though Valve's focus is largely now on a new MOBA: Deadlock .

content.v: 《GTA6》发售预告展示了景观、角色和游戏世界，也成为一篇R星历代作品预告回顾的起点。游戏将于11月19日发售；这篇回顾梳理了R星如何逐步把预告重点从 开放世界 中的活动转向人物与故事。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792099209_948318_jpg_r.jpg
回顾从2001年的《GTA3》开始。当时的预告着重展示自由城、车辆驾驶和街头 暴力 ，叙事场景较少。到了《GTA：罪恶 都市 》，音乐、色彩和城市氛围更加突出；《GTA：圣安地列斯》则进一步将CJ、故事和不同地区放到预告中心。
《GTA4》的预告围绕尼科初到自由城的经历展开，更强调人物关系。《荒野大镖客》则借约翰·马斯顿的讲述，引出逐渐消逝的西部世界。
之后，《给他爱5》用简短片段呈现城市与多名主角；《荒野大镖客2》在约一分钟内传达亚瑟·摩根所处时代及故事的沉重感。回顾作者将《GTA6》预告视为这一变化的延续，并认为其视觉呈现与机制复杂度有所提升。

items.summary: Three top-tier survival crafting games have entered their 1.0 era.

content.v: Attention fellow base-building ghouls and survival masochists, I've got good news and bad news. Starting with the good: Some of the best survival crafting games are no longer in early access, and have hit their 1.0 milestones. The bad news? Three of them piled into the same one-month window.

I've seen a million posts all asking the same advice: "Should I get Valheim, RuneScape Dragonwilds, or Enshrouded first?" And as someone who can't stop sinking hundreds of hours into mining the same three types of rock, I'm qualified enough to help you decide. I've also recruited my colleague, Chris Livingston, who is always up to in-game riffraff resulting in funny animal encounters or injuries like some sort of bizarre, survival-crafting Jeff Corwin.

content.v: 《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》发售之际，开发商Evil Empire谈到了游戏的节奏调整。团队曾尝试沉重、缓慢的战斗，也试过进一步加快动作速度，最终希望让战斗手感与探索比重取得平衡。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792097601_766798_jpg_r.jpg
开发团队表示，游戏在制作期间经历过许多版本。一个早期方案更接近《黑暗之魂》：战斗沉重，整体节奏较慢，难度和强度也更高。开发者后来认为，这种设计过慢、过于紧绷，没有呈现他们希望保留的《恶魔城》感觉。
团队随后加快了游戏速度，却发现它变得太像《死亡细胞》，探索所占的比重不足。最终的方向是保留《恶魔城》系列的探索和较从容的推进节奏，同时让动作操作足够顺畅。Evil Empire曾参与《死亡细胞》的后续开发及其与《恶魔城》的联动内容。团队负责人还表示，与Konami合作时，他们既重视自身对创作的控制权，也需要考虑系列玩家的期待。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792097602_636634_jpg_r.jpg
游戏登陆Steam数小时后，并发玩家峰值达到17896人，超过访谈所列《死亡细胞》的历史峰值。这是发售初期的即时数据；开发团队当时表示，仍在等待玩家反馈。

items.title: 《街头霸王》评论综述：抱歉，伙计们，但这听起来一团糟
items.summary: The general consensus seems to be that Street Fighter isn't a disaster, but it definitely misses a lot more th

content.v: I had such high hopes for the Street Fighter movie: The trailers were so promising, the cast so charismatic, and it seemed to get the inherent ridiculousness of the franchise, playing it seriously without ever really taking it too seriously. I mean, you don't put a guy like David Dastmalchian in the role of M. Bison unless you expect him to do something with it, right?

Alas, it seems that this may be a real Tuesday , at least for my Street Fighter movie aspirations. The reviews are in, and they are not especially kind. Street Fighter isn't a complete catastrophe, according to the critical consensus, but I don't think JCVD has to worry about having to turn in his "Best Street Fighter Movie" trophy anytime soon, either.
Here's what they're saying:
"Dumber than a box of rocks, but have you ever thrown rocks at things? It can be pretty fun"

The story is too thin to support its bloated roster, but IGN reckons the Street Fighter film is "all about landing as many punches as it can before the round timer hits zero. Even though there are plenty of misses, the ones it does manage to land hit hard."
"A garish and incoherent mess that amuses in fits and starts but barely improves on the Mortal Kombat movies before it"
The Guardian : 2/5

Fans might enjoy the new SF flick, and the performances are "likeable," but its repeated self-knowing acknowledgment of how silly it all is "would land better if the movie ever rose above the stuff it’s making fun of. Instead, Street Fighter is satisfied punching down on itself, and everything that’s cringe about the '90s, while happily being stuck there, in the past, so it could pretend that this is as good as it gets for videogame adaptations."
"Not a great adaptation of what is one of the most recognizable brands in all of gaming"
Collider : 6/10

"The movie is at its most fun when it truly locks in for those high-octane fights and the surprisingly beautiful and not-much-publicized animated sequences," Collider reviewer Aidan Kelley wrote. "Unfortunately, to get to those, you have to deal with a lot of exposition and unengaging character drama."
"One of the most overtly mixed bags of any movie this year"
ScreenRant : 7/10

Despite calling Street Fighter "a fundamentally flawed movie on an underlying storytelling level," ScreenRant's review is one of the more positive takes floating around out there: The film is "buoyed by the overall 'go for broke' tone" and director Kitao Sakurai's "great work helming the film, working with the cast and crew to deliver consistently entertaining fight scenes that are flush with personality and style."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7AEvKY9uAw3kAc522RUdQc-1920-80.jpg
"Like a trip to a ’90s mall arcade, Street Fighter’s pretty fun — for about 30 minutes"
ScreenCrush : 5/10

"The sheer absurdity and fevered intensity of the pacing, not to mention some very athletic fight choreography, is good enough to carry things along through the jittery first act," reviewer Matt Singer wrote for ScreenCrush. "But you can only mainline caffeine for so long before it starts to give you a headache."
"A campy '90s nostalgia ride and a complete mess"
Associated Press : 1/4

Street Fighter is a "very enthusiastic, weirdly convoluted and jumbled mess of a movie," Jake Coyle wrote for AP. As much as you might think a Street Fighter movie, good or bad, would at least offer up some bluntly entertaining hand-to-hand combat, it’s so messily plotted and chaotically conceived that it makes a game with six buttons seem comparatively artful."
"Dull fight scenes and tonal whiplash make this mostly forgettable videogame adaptation work only for superfans"
The Film Verdict

Street Fighter "is a little bit of everything that amounts to a lot of not-much," The Film Verdict declared, comparing it unfavorably to this year's Mortal Kombat and Resident Evil flicks: Street Fighter has all the elements that made those films successful, "but never lands on a formula than functions."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TemaybzeHpFVorpFjtMon9-1920-80.jpg
"I’m not sure Street Fighter meets any conventional standard of quality, but it’s undeniably its own thing"
The Wrap

This review takes a more holistic approach to Street Fighter, calling it "an action-packed, hyper-stylized, borderline-nonsensical fever dream with a central storyline that begs to be taken seriously" despite being goofy, horny, largely incoherent, and somehow "even weirder" than the 1990s movie. But hey, maybe that's your thing: As reviewer William Bibbiani wrote, "What even is a 'good movie' anyway?"
"A jumbled tonal mess that feels deadly serious one moment and like parody the next"
The Hollywood Reporter

"Featuring so many characters and elements from the games that non-aficionados are left desperately attempting to keep up, Street Fighter tries to thread the needle between fan service and welcoming the uninitiated," THR says. "The result is that neither camp is likely to be fully satisfied."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sfTe253Q4iGfinopcVdMZ-1920-80.jpg
"Not even close to coherent, but it does have some good fight scenes"
Gizmodo

Gizmodo's review says the Street Fighter film is a bit like its portrayal of Ken Masters, an oafish clown who can actually fight: "The editing choices, scene transitions, and even the basic plot are frequently baffling. And yet, it can throw a punch when it wants to."
"The closest any filmmaker has come to bringing the franchise’s signature verve and bombast to the big screen"
Inverse

In another relatively positive review, Inverse declares that "Street Fighter might not be a film that sticks in your brain for days afterwards, but while you’re in your seat it feels like a shot of adrenaline to the arm, the kind that you might get from hearing the coveted 'You Win' announcement after the end of a hard-fought match."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HCfj9eghzaAFWKedhbTr5n-1920-80.jpg
"Something goes terribly awry in its back half, hinting at either a troubled production, or one that was doomed from the start"
Variety

Variety was impressed by Street Fighter's strong start, but says the wheels come off in the second half: "It’s a film at war with itself, in which a straightforward narrative about strained brotherhood is spread far too thin across unconnected snippets of action and comedy that grow increasingly disparate."

So there you have it: Not a disaster, but definitely a mess. We'll hopefully have our own critical take on the Street Fighter film up eventually, if we can ever talk Mollie Taylor into going to see it; in the meantime, if you've seen it, let us know what you think.

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》将于10月23日发售，登陆PS5、XSX|S、PC和Switch2平台，本作首发不会加入XGP，订阅用户想要在发售时游玩，必须单独购买游戏本体。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792097146_877458_jpg_r.jpg
微软今年早些时候调整了XGP运营策略：第一方新作依旧保持首日入库，但今后的《使命召唤》新作不再首发登陆XGP终极版与PC版XGP，新作会采用时间窗口模式，大约发售一整年之后，才会加入订阅服务库。按照官方给出的时间点，《现代战争4》预计要等到2027年假日季才会进入。
该策略变动伴随XGP订阅价格下调同步推出。已经在XGP库内的老款《使命召唤》作品不会被移除，微软还计划后续继续往订阅库追加系列旧作。
《使命召唤：现代战争4》会登陆Switch2平台，这也是COD系列自2013年之后，时隔多年重返任天堂主机平台。游戏为独立完整作品，不依赖其他COD游戏即可游玩。

items.title: 《魔兽世界：无限》首发加入千余任务与四个区域
items.summary: 《魔兽世界：无限》是暴雪面向未来打造的全新版本，团队希望借本作打破MMORPG固有的设计框架，不只是简单翻新旧有内容。开发团队表示，项目的核心目标是解决当代MMO普遍面临的难题：玩家内容消耗过快、版本更新间隔漫长、后期游

content.v: 《魔兽世界：无限》是暴雪面向未来打造的全新版本，团队希望借本作打破MMORPG固有的设计框架，不只是简单翻新旧有内容。开发团队表示，项目的核心目标是解决当代MMO普遍面临的难题：玩家内容消耗过快、版本更新间隔漫长、后期游玩内容匮乏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792095953_288995_jpg_r.jpg
本作对任务、副本、 开放世界 玩法都做出了革新。游戏不再强制玩家按固定顺序推进主线，大量区域、任务可以自由解锁。世界动态事件不再是简单重复刷怪，事件会根据玩家行为发生连锁变化，世界状态能够产生长期改变。开发组称，他们希望打造一个“会记住玩家所作所为”的艾泽拉斯。
装备系统也迎来改动，摒弃部分老旧的装备碾压式循环。套装、特效装备依旧存在，但不再让每一轮新版本直接作废上版本绝大多数毕业装备。开发者提到，他们希望降低反复刷取装备的压迫感，让玩家可以留存自己喜爱的配装，同时依旧保留追求更强装备的动力。
针对发售之后的内容规划，团队并没有规划传统意义上的大型资料片。取而代之的是持续、分段式的内容更新节奏：大型剧情篇章、中小型故事章节、区域迭代、新的团队副本与五人地下城，会以更密集的节奏分批推出。
开发人员解释，传统大型资料片模式的弊端在于，玩家需要等待数年才能迎来重大内容，漫长空窗期会造成大量玩家流失。新模式下，故事不会被割裂成独立资料片，剧情连贯延续，艾泽拉斯世界会随着更新持续演变。
但团队也承认这套新模式存在风险。频繁更新会带来平衡性、BUG、内容打磨的挑战，暴雪需要维持稳定的开发产能。因此本作依旧保留季度大更新，穿插小型补丁修复BUG、加入限时活动。
PVP方面，开发组计划弱化强制排位的压力，提供更多休闲向对抗玩法;同时兼顾硬核竞技群体，竞技场、评级战场会继续保留。关于玩家群体分化问题，团队表示会兼顾休闲玩家与硬核玩家。主线故事不用高难度副本门槛即可体验;高难度团本、顶尖奖励则留给追求挑战的核心受众。被问及怀旧服的未来，官方称《魔兽世界：无限》并不会取代怀旧服，怀旧服会继续独立运营。
开发者最后表示，这次的设计是一次大胆尝试。如果这套持续迭代模式取得成功，它会定义魔兽世界未来数十年的发展路径。如果效果不及预期，团队也会灵活调整更新策略。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Auroch Digital与Big Fan Games已推出《战锤40K：爆矢枪2》，游戏登陆PC、PS5和Xbox Series X|S。续作直接承接前作结尾，延续 复古 画面和快速战斗，并加入第二名可操作角色、新武器与敌人。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792095487_727161.jpg
玩家可以选择装备和战斗风格不同的两名角色：回归的极限战士马尔姆·凯多，以及新登场的战斗修女奈拉·贝拉斯。后者侧重快速挥刃作战。
关卡设有可探索区域和隐藏秘密。敌人包括来自不同势力的新对手，以及纳垢灵和邪教徒。剧情中，半神瓦什托尔引发巨大爆炸，帝国舰队遭受严重打击，两名主角由此踏上阻止其计划的任务。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261016/1792095489_249810.jpg
游戏收录以吉他和鼓声烘托战斗的原创配乐，其中包括曾为《毁灭战士：永恒》创作音乐的Mick Gordon所写的新曲。日文资料列出的售价为3150日元。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: Galaxies 2026 年秋季展示会：一切均已公布

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/galaxies-br-1791344074580-1792094589645.png
2026 年 Galaxies 秋季展示会已经到来，其中展示了超过 50 款令人兴奋的游戏，包括《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》、《总决赛》、《InZOI》等等。
正如您所看到的，有大量的公告，因此我们认为我们应该在这里收集所有最重要的时刻，以确保您不会错过任何事情！全部检查一遍，并在下面的评论中告诉我们您最喜欢哪些游戏！
《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》发布预告片让我们更加兴奋地投入其中
《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》现已在 PS5、Xbox Series X/S、Nintendo Switch 和 PC 上推出，银河秋季展示会也发布了发布预告片，现在我们更加兴奋地开始玩了！
总决赛的黄金时段即将变得特别
总决赛正在为 2026 年 10 月 20 日的黄金时段做好准备，这似乎是自推出以来规模最大的一场。期待重新制作的竞技场、更锐利的外观，甚至“比以往更多的抢风头方式”。
克莱夫·巴克 (Clive Barker) 的《猛鬼追魂》复兴版预告片让我们以最好的方式感到害怕
克莱夫·巴克 (Clive Barker) 的《猛鬼追魂》并未在 PS5、Xbox Series X/S、Switch 2 和 PC 上推出，游戏的发布预告片让我们感到无比恐惧，同时也很兴奋能够体验这款由 Saber Interactive 开发的生存动作恐怖游戏。
通过这个新的发布预告片来了解 Frosthaven 1.0
Frosthaven 已正式发布 1.0 版本更新，玩家可以查看发布预告片，重新了解这对于 Snapshot Games 开发的战术回合制 RPG 意味着什么。
我们迫不及待地想在《我的企鹅朋友》中与丁丁成为最好的朋友
我可以肯定地说，我们都会喜欢一个小企鹅朋友，而《我的企鹅朋友》希望通过让我们通过丁丁（一只住在沿海村庄的勇敢的小鸟）的眼睛来探索它的眼睛，从而实现这个愿望。
我的企鹅朋友即将登陆 PC。
寻找加密致命病毒背后的真相
我们第一次看到了 Encryption，这是一款即将推出的第一人称恐怖游戏，玩家可以在其中探索一个被病毒摧毁的世界。为了寻求真相，玩家需要深入设施的危险下层，我们都知道这通常不会顺利。
Appulse 看起来是弹球游戏的令人兴奋的新尝试
Appulse 是一款自上而下的动作街机弹球射击游戏，它引起了我们的注意，因为它要求玩家通过获得升级、掌握阵列或武器以及在星际战争中生存来确保母舰的安全，免受敌方机器人的侵害。给我们报名吧。
Appulse 将于 11 月 26 日在 PC 上推出，并且现已提供演示。
与您的朋友一起用一盘喂养怪物！
叫上一些朋友，准备好在“One More Plate!”中喂食一些怪物！这是一款即将推出的基于物理的合作派对游戏，您必须为饥饿的怪物提供各种盘子和形状！
再来一盘！将于 2026 年 11 月 10 日在 PC 上发布。
Guns of Eschaton 是一款以末日西方世界为背景的第一人称魂类动作射击游戏
我们很喜欢 IGN 的《灵魂之类》，而《末日之枪》似乎是对这一类型的独特诠释，将其设定在一个世界末日的西方世界。哦，它是第一人称动作射击游戏。
《末世之枪》将于 2026 年 12 月 8 日在 PS5、Xbox Series X/S 和 PC 上发布。
《祖先：人类奥德赛》将于 12 月登陆主机平台
《先祖：人类奥德赛》将于 12 月 8 日登陆 PS5、Xbox Series X/S 和 Nintendo Switch 2，通过纪录片风格的旁白、照片模式和生活质量改进等新功能，让玩家探索人类出现之前的时代。 PC 玩家也将在 12 月 8 日获得此升级。
成为准备好品尝自由滋味的发条玩具
Lelu 是 Jamierowan 开发的即将推出的动作冒险单色探索游戏，将于 2027 年 1 月 21 日登陆 Nintendo Switch 2 和 PC。准备好成为一个有意识的发条玩具，准备好尝尝自由的滋味吧。
《重力电路 2》获得演示版和精美预告片
《Mega Man X》粉丝应该注意 Gravity Circuit 2，这是由 Domesticated Ant Games 开发的即将推出的 2D 动作平台游戏续集。随着新方舟的出现，当游戏于 2027 年春季上市时，玩家可以体验《重力》或《动力电路》。为了帮助您缓解等待，Steam 上现已提供演示版。
《Voidwood》在 Steam 上进行游戏测试
Steam 玩家可以查看 Voidwood 的 pre-alpha 游戏测试，这是一款即将推出的 1-4 人合作生存恐怖游戏，其中近距离语音聊天是危险的一部分。玩家必须沟通才能生存，但野兽总是在倾听。
《Voidwood》将于 2027 年底通过 Steam 发布 PC 版。
修补匠岛获得演示和游戏预告片
Tinker Island 是一款多人沙盒游戏，背景设置在充满热带岛屿的独特海洋世界中，您现在可以在 Steam 上查看该游戏的演示。
您现在就可以体验一款名为 Appa 的叙事卡牌战斗游戏
你现在可以去看看名为 Appa 的叙事驱动卡牌战斗游戏，因为游戏测试目前正在进行中。你将能够了解更多关于这款游戏的内容，你将扮演两个兄弟姐妹，与他们父亲的去世达成和解。
《Squad》将于 2027 年登陆主机平台
《Squad》是一款现已在 PC 上推出的战术 FPS 游戏，将于 2027 年在 PS5 和 Xbox Series X/S 上发布。为了帮助大家缓解等待，PS5 上的免费 Alpha 预览版即将于 10 月 16 日至 10 月 25 日推出。
享受 inZOI 的新游戏
享受 inZOI 的全新面貌，这款即将推出的生活模拟游戏让玩家可以“按照自己的具体要求过上各种各样的生活，从抚养孩子到在阳光下享受乐趣”。
inZOI 现已推出适用于 Mac 和 PC 的抢先体验版，该阶段即将结束。
在最新的《Vaultbreakers》预告片中了解巴哈拉任务
再看看《Vaultbreakers》并了解有关巴哈拉任务的所有信息。对于那些不熟悉的人来说，Vaultbreakers 是一款自上而下的提取 RPG，玩家可以在其中展开 PvE 或 PvPvE 冒险。
感兴趣的人可以从今天（10 月 15 日至 10 月 21 日）开始在 Steam 上进行 alpha 测试。
特技演员：好莱坞预告片展示霹雳游侠游戏玩法
《特技演员：好莱坞》的最新版本让我们看到了一些激动人心的《霹雳游侠》游戏玩法，并揭示了游戏的更多内容，您可以在其中“表演受大片启发的爆炸性场景，反抗危险，并一路漂流成为明星”。
艾尔塔：反抗诸神获得演示和新游戏预告片
快来看看《Elta: Defy All Gods》的一些新游戏玩法，然后立即亲自体验演示版。在这款游戏中，玩家将在各种科幻世界中进行自由的近战战斗，努力成为堕落之神艾尔塔的最终冠军。
《艾尔塔：反抗诸神》将于 2027 年 2 月 2 日在 PS5、Xbox Series X/S 和 PC 上发布。
《模拟火车世界 7》即将推出大量新内容
《模拟火车世界 7》正在进行重大更新，包括新路线、经典火车等等。 《模拟火车世界 7》现已登陆 PC、Xbox Series X/S 和 PS5。对游戏感到好奇的玩家也可以立即尝试《模拟火车世界 7：免费版》。

items.summary: The acclaimed PC shooter, Squad, is coming to consoles and PS5 players will be able to experience it very soon

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/squad-1791932752259.jpg
The acclaimed PC shooter, Squad , is coming to consoles — and PS5 players will be able to experience it very soon.

Developer Offworld Industries has announced that Squad will be making its way to Xbox Series X|S and PS5. PlayStation players will be able to give it a whirl later this month with a playable alpha, which will take place from October 16 - 25. Xbox players will have to wait for the full release, unless Offworld provides another opportunity to test the console version out ahead of launch.

The developer has promised an optimised experience for console with handpicked maps, a "bespoke polish for flawless performance," optional crossplay with other consoles, and new communication methods via a radial wheel that allows you to issue commands and pings. The game is expected to bring its 50v50 matches to the consoles, as well.

If you're interested in checking out the alpha on PS5, you can click here to sign up . As of right now, there's no release date for Squad's console version. The PC version of the game launched in 2020, and it has been one of the more beloved tactical shooters on Steam for some time. Before Wardogs ever came into the picture, Squad attempted to strike a balance between the milsim nature of Arma with the more fast-paced action of more mainstream shooters like Call of Duty or Battlefield.

It'll be interesting to see if Squad can beat Wardogs to consoles. Bulkhead has already announced that Wardogs will hit consoles in 2028 and recently told IGN that expects the game to also have a port on next-gen hardware, when it becomes available. The studio also revealed that it has been building Wardogs with Xbox Series S in mind, ensuring that not only will it be optimized for consoles, but also for lower-end PCs.

items.title: 为什么 Rockstar 取消了 GTA 4 的 PlayStation 独占后续作品
items.summary: At E3 2009, Sony announced that it was partnering with Rockstar on a PlayStation-exclusive spy game called Age

content.v: At E3 2009, Sony announced that it was partnering with Rockstar on a PlayStation-exclusive spy game called Agent , with Rockstar founders Sam and Dan Houser overseeing development. The game never materialized, though, and now Dan Houser has shared more details as to why.

Speaking to IGN , Houser said Agent never coming out shouldn't be a total shock because he worked on "a bunch of games that never came out." He said Rockstar tried with two or three different teams to make Agent--an open-world spy game--but the teams just "could not get it right."
"And it never came out. We concluded that it was not a game we were ever going to figure out how to make. Other people can try, but I personally think it's hard," he said.
Great spy movies like the James Bond series work so well because they take viewers all over the world, but "that's not an experience in an open-world game that really works," Houser said.
"So we tried lots of things and couldn't get it quite right," Houser said, going on to say that the teams built great elements but they never came together in a full package.
Images of Agent, which was reportedly set in the '70s, have emerged over the years, showing off some of what Rockstar was planning.
In 2009, then-Take-Two president Ben Feder told GameSpot that Agent was being positioned to be the next Grand Theft Auto .

“It’s the A team working on an AAA title,” he said at the time. “I think the subject matter, the characters, the story, the environment, the background–all the elements are there. It’s such a rich environment to play in.”
Across the industry, games get canceled regularly-- Blizzard has said it cancels 50% of the games it starts --but Rockstar's Agent got more traction because of the studio's profile.

Rockstar never gave Agent a release date, but it would have followed up 2008's Grand Theft Auto 4. The next game that Rockstar North led development on after GTA 4 was 2013's GTA 5, and now Rockstar North is set to release GTA 6 on November 19.

items.title: 《使命召唤：MW4》不在 Xbox Game Pass 上，但您可以期待它
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is set for release on October 23, and in a big shakeup, it will not be availabl

content.v: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is set for release on October 23, and in a big shakeup, it will not be available on Xbox Game Pass at launch.

This has been known for a while, but Activision is reminding people of this in a new blog post on the eve of the game's campaign early access on October 16. In fact, Activision has been warning people that MW4 is not on Game Pass for months now , so the blog post is just the latest example of this.
Upon release, the only way to get MW4 is by purchasing it outright, starting at $70 for the base edition and scaling to $100 for the Vault edition.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/MW4NewGame_eef119.jpg?w=636
When will MW4 come to Game Pass?
Activision said MW4 will be available on Xbox Game Pass at some point at the end of next year, meaning it will be "windowed" as a standalone purchase for about one year.
Why are new Call of Duty games no longer included with Game Pass?

2024’s Black Ops 6 was the first entry in the series to launch directly into Xbox Game Pass, with Black Ops 7 following the same playbook in 2025. However, Microsoft announced earlier this year that new Call of Duty titles would no longer debut in Game Pass , an announcement it made in conjunction with a price cut for the subscription service.

Microsoft has never explicitly said why it made this major change, but it could have to do with lost sales. It was reported that Black Ops 6 coming to Game Pass in 2024 amounted to Microsoft missing out on hundreds of millions of dollars in revenue . That number has been debated, and it does not tell the whole story, but no doubt there was a financial impact that Microsoft is responding to.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma is undertaking a "reset" of the Xbox business, and cutting new Call of Duty games from Game Pass is part of that. She is also trying to revive Xbox console exclusives , including a nuclear option .
What other Call of Duty games are on Game Pass?
Although Game Pass Ultimate subscribers can't play MW4 until next year, the catalog currently includes a bunch of older entries in the series.

items.title: 《魔兽世界：永远》的开发者表示，装备升级将在“很长一段时间内”保持相关性：“我们非常愿意尽一切努力不使旧内容失效”
items.summary: Blizzard says items won't work like the modern version of the MMO.

content.v: The developers of World of Warcraft: Forever, the venerable MMO's newest 'Classic+' flavor, say that even though the level cap is staying at 60, there will always be new gear to chase, and lower level gear has never been more powerful.

Blizzard Entertainment developers are wary of the drastic increases in power in WoW's modern version, including the recent Midnight expansion, which render previous seasons of gear irrelevant, require massive resets between expansions and lead to periodic stat "squishes" to avoid players becoming omnipotent gods.

"Classic wasn't far off from this," vice president and senior game director Ion Hazzikostas said of Forever's approach in a recent PC Gamer interview. "It's gradual. Going from [Classic raids] Blackwing Lair to Ahn'Qiraj that's actually only a couple of item levels higher. Those two largely coexist. C'thun drops are probably better than anything in Blackwing Lair, but that's like one or two items per player. This is a system that can last for a long, long time."
Associate production director Clay Stone says that's part of what makes gear in Forever—and Classic—meaningful.
"Your best-in-slot that you pick up from a previous raid tier may continue to be your best in slot for a long time. It's very much our intention to try wherever we can to not invalidate old content."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R2g2nfNeCoSe5bX8wvJYgY-1920-80.jpg
Then again, a long time isn't expected to be literally forever, Hazzikostas says.
"At some point, if you're running the Barrow Deeps raid that's coming out in December, you're going to have all the items that you want. That's fine. You're done with it."

Forever players will see gear progress at level 60: those modest item level increases, gear that's good in specific niche situations, and rare "chase" pieces should keep people hunting, Forever developers say.
An item might be especially powerful when fighting in a desert, or against a dragon, for example, making it particularly good in one especially tough fight.

(And yes, players, developers are aware that this means bag space will be at a premium. "We're already thinking about that," principal designer Kris Zierhut says, mentioning the ideas of more bank space, trinket bags or even garment bags to hold the excess.)
Un-solving the game
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TWf2yNegExMxJxn3T6vQ9Y-1920-80.jpg

Forever launches on November 4, and so far players have seen few of the pieces that will entice them at the end game. The current level cap in the beta is 30, and future items have been hidden from view and datamining to keep them guessing.

"We resurrected some old tech that keeps item stats and properties and tooltips secret, unknown to the client, until the item has actually been obtained by someone on the server," Hazzikostas says. "That's something we can use in modern WoW if we want."

Essentially a flag on items determines whether they are known, making them visible in the game's data. It trips when someone discovers an item for the first time, making sure that if the player links the item to others, it doesn't cause bugs

But until that moment, players can't get a sneak peek at what the piece of gear does. It's one reason why Forever doesn't have an Adventure Guide for dungeons; developers want the game to keep its secrets.

"Every single boss in our raids has some items that are very low percentage drop chase items, kind of like the Dragonspine Trophy was in Gruul's Lair—but for every boss," says Zierhut. "It might be three weeks, four weeks before somebody sees that item drop, and the whole meta is torn up again."
The goal is to keep the magic of exploration alive, he says.

"The goal is to un-solve the game, so players have to figure out again what's the best path," Zierhut says. "They don't know what the best items are. They don't know what to get. It's back to 2004 and nobody knows anything and figuring it out all over again."
Hand-crafted power
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Mxxu8paSa2qdYUVMb398kX-1920-80.jpg

To add a layer of complexity—and, again, keep players from gaining power too quickly—items deliberately aren't optimized for players' preferred classes and stats. "Our items are much more idiosyncratic, and you don't get exactly what you want," he says, noting that knowing your class and choosing between gear sets will be one way players express skill in Forever. "None of the gear is perfect."

That's an old strategy—there are oft-discussed items from WoW's original launch that put strength on cloth gear, for example—but what is new is how much power items can have at a relatively low level.
Both low-level drops and crafted gear are powerful early, and that's on purpose, developers say.

"A lot of times tradeskills felt like an afterthought in Classic. Like, 'Oh, I could craft this item, but it's too much work and I'm about to out-level it anyway. Skip it. I'll level up my tailor when I get to level 60,' " Zierhut says. "I made a deliberate effort to make more crafting recipes worthwhile to craft while you are leveling up, including lowering the skill requirement to craft them.

"The typical item from tailoring, leatherworking, blacksmithing requires 25 fewer skill points than it used to. So you'll be able to craft that item right around the time it's your best-in-slot at that level and get the real value out of doing it."
Much of the tuning done so far to gear in Forever's beta has been to keep that idea of modest but steady progression across the whole leveling process.
"It's just a slightly different gradient in terms of power level," lead game designer Tim Jones says.

items.title: 由于人工智能反编译和移植的泛滥，大规模反编译社区正在关闭
items.summary: If you've been on gaming Twitter at all over the last month, you're probably aware of a massive wave of people

content.v: https://assets1.ignimgs.com/2021/03/01/halo-cortana-1614607712316.jpg

If you've been on gaming Twitter at all over the last month, you're probably aware of the massive wave of people using AI to rapidly decompile, port, and remix games. That wave of AI decomps has forced a massive decompilation community to sunset.

In a blog post, admin @encounter from decomp.dev , a community repository for people to track decompilation posts, cites a wave of bad actors who are using AI to essentially steal the hard work of programmers working on existing decompilation projects.

The act of decompiling games itself isn't new, and people have been taking games and trying to decompile them down to the source code for years. But what was once a herculean task requiring coding expertise can now be done with little effort thanks to new AI models like GPT 6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5.

The blog post doesn't blame the models themselves for the surge of vibe-coded decompilations and ports, but rather claims that bad actors are taking existing projects and then using AI to rush them to completion. While there might be some developers who are open to people with a Claude subscription using their work to create, say, a browser port of Halo , that should be up to each developer.

The post says, "Every project works differently: some may not want to use AI for legal or ethical reasons, and others may be okay with AI, or use AI themselves, but do not want drive-by contributions from folks who have put no effort into making sure the contributions are good. The bottom line is that these kinds of hostile forks put little to no effort into meaningfully contributing to existing projects, tearing apart our community fabric."

As for the ports themselves, the blog claims that people are taking the code from hobbyists and forcing a barely functioning port out of them. "While community members put in the effort to decompile a game, opportunists have frequently raced to release a half-baked, barely-functional port from it," @encounter writes.

The blog post also mentions that this recent wave of AI decomps, recomps, and ports is muddying the waters of what the decomp community is trying to do. A lot of classical decomps are done out of the love of games and a desire to know how they work, but this trend of using AI to brute force working PC ports has caused a lot of people to rush into communities like decomp.dev looking for simple ways to create easy PC ports of games.
As for decomp.dev itself, the website will still exist, and users can use it to track existing projects, but @encounter is taking down the main index and disabling new projects.

Unfortunately, when it comes to Opus 5.5, Astra 6, and decomps, the cat is out of the bag, and it's unlikely that one decomp repository going offline is going to meaningfully stop this trend. We've seen everything from making Minecraft playable on X/Twitter to modders shoving Minecraft and Elden Ring together . There have also been a lot of browser ports, with games like Halo: Combat Evolved and Grand Theft Auto 5 being briefly playable on Chrome before those games' respective publishers predictibly brought them crashing down.

Either way, it's a shame to see a community built out of the love of programming essentially die off because a bunch of people with Claude subscriptions are using game developers' work as a starting point and finishing it with AI.

items.summary: IO Interactive has announced the release date for 007 First Light's long-delayed Switch 2 version--March 18, 2

content.v: IO Interactive has announced the release date for 007 First Light's long-delayed Switch 2 version--March 18, 2027--and that's not all. People who preorder the game for Switch 2 are getting something no other platform has: a ridiculously oversized tie.

Not just any ridiculously oversized tie, however. People who preorder First Light for Switch 2 get the GoldenEye Suit, and it includes the suit and tie that Pierce Brosnan wore in the famous 1995 movie, including the oversized tie.
Brosnan wore a lot of suits in that movie, but the one being referenced here is the one with the oversized tie, which was the style at the time.

GoldenEye has a special history with Nintendo specifically, which may help explain why Switch 2 owners are getting this outfit and no one else is. After all, 1997's GoldenEye 007, which was based on the movie, is one of the most iconic N64 games of all time.
First Light has been a big hit, critically and commercially, scoring great reviews and selling more than 4 million copies , and that's before the Switch 2 version even comes out.
The Switch 2 version of First Light was supposed to launch alongside the other versions in May 2026, but was later delayed multiple times. IO said a combination of factors contributed to delays.

In addition to the forthcoming Switch 2 version of First Light, IO is working on a new fantasy game. However, after Xbox pulled funding, IO laid off staff. Many also want to see IO work on the expected sequel to First Light , but no official announcements have been made.

items.title: 世嘉因 AI 升级图形引发强烈反对而下架《全面战争：幕府将军 2 重制版》
items.summary: Following player backlash, Sega and Creative Assembly have yanked Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from

others.title: Sega Pulls Disastrous Total War: Shogun 2 Remaster From Sale Following Backlash

content.v: Following player backlash, Sega and Creative Assembly have yanked Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from sale and have replaced it with the original 2011 version. First hitting digital shelves on October 13, this version of the beloved strategy game was advertised as having had a substantial facelift, but it wasn't long before players pointed out numerous issues with the game and the telltale sign of AI-upscaling. This has led to some bizarre makeovers, like a samurai's face merging with his helmet or extra fingers on character artwork.

"We're aware that Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition has fallen short of both your expectations and our own standards," Sega wrote in a statement that did not address the AI criticisms at all. "We've seen your feedback, comments, and reviews. We agree that the current experience is not where it needs to be."

Fans have also taken to social media to show off legacy bugs that still haven't been addressed in this new edition, and Sega said that it's "working closely" with its "development partners" to identify and address these issues. Unsurprisingly, the game has an overwhelmingly negative rating on Steam currently, with over 81% of players urging people to give it a skip.

"Horrific graphical bug makes the vegetation in battle map terrible to look at. There's no way to disable the vegetation," one oddly specific player review reads," amongst hundreds of other negative pieces of feedback.

Players also weren't happy when Sega initially replaced the original Shogun 2 game with the remastered version, which has a price tag of $40. Upgrading from the classic to this version will cost you $10. The AI-upscaling is just the tip of the complaints-iceberg, as players have several other issues with Shogun 2. The new user interface has been criticized for its clunky design and plenty of new bugs have surfaced. This isn't the only game using generative AI that Sega is linked to, as for the upcoming Crazy Taxi: World Tour, generative AI was used to create background assets.

items.title: GTA 5 finally measures up to the actual best GTA game now I've added a jetpack
items.summary: Zoom.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
World War 2 Canadian air force pilot John Gillespie Magee Jr once wrote, in his poem High Flight:
Oh! I have slipped the surly bonds of Earth And danced the skies on laughter-silvered wings; Sunward I've climbed, and joined the tumbling mirth of sun-split clouds,—and done a hundred things

He was talking about Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, his favourite game and an icon of the PS2 generation of consoles. In San Andreas, tucked away in the Verdant Meadows Airstrip, the player could locate a jetpack, and tumble through the skies of Las Venturas like a glorious errant star. GTA 5? No jetpack. This is why it's an inferior game.

Until now. I have installed Aerowing - Wearable Jet Pack & Weapon System . Or, well, I installed it, tried to launch the game, crashed my PC, rebooted, tried to launch the game, crashed the game, rebooted, then launched the game.

It's a strangely lavish mod, I'll give it that. You don't just tap F and sort of limply ascend, which is mostly how it went in San Andreas. No, you get a whole animation, the camera circles your guy as he does a possibly-copyrighted Iron Man pose and launches himself skywards.
Then off you go, a speedometer in the corner measuring your courage as you glide along, launching one of three weapons: SMG, plasma, and "tube," which I'm pretty sure is just SMG again.

It's a rollocking good time, and it'll be even better once I find a way to proc it that doesn't also proc my street golfing mod. Until then, with silent lifting mind I'll tread the high untrespassed sanctity of space, put out my hand, and touch the face of God.

items.title: Come on Razer what are you doing? This Pokemon-themed mouse is most definitely not the one
items.summary: Now listen, I'm no designer, but...

content.v: Upcoming Pokemon x Razer Viper V4 Pro https://t.co/qsAKwBhcg8 October 15, 2026

For a company that has made the best mouse I've ever laid my hands on, it sure seems to be doing its darndest to destroy that mystique. That is, assuming the latest images from Razer on Chinese site Billibilli of a Pokemon-themed Viper V4 Pro come to fruition (via Jakeu ). You can see it in the Tweet above, in all its glory—what do you think?

I think it looks bloody awful. There's just something about that peculiar mix of grey, yellow, and green that seems very uncoordinated. That, and the fact that the pixel art and yellow Poke-circle on the body of the mouse seem about as seamless as your average in-game graffiti emote. Just slapped on there without a care in the world.

I'm being harsh, but to be fair, this is right off the back of hearing about another potential version of the Viper V4 Pro that might cost $300 . At least, if the currency conversion is relevant and it is indeed listed for sale in the Chinese market, as is claimed.
Why can't a good thing be left alone? The Viper V4 Pro is fantastic, and that's in part because it looks sleek and simple, and because it's cheaper than other top-end gaming mice from big brands.
There's a chair, too, and a keyboard, which my colleague James says he prefers the look of to the mouse. I think I agree, but I still think the the grey clashes too much with the green.
Back to the Viper, though, there could have been a chance here to make a proper red-and-white, pokeball-themed version, but instead we get this grey-and-whatever-else monstrosity.
I'll just keep hold of the white one, thank you very much.

items.title: The AI bubble may not have burst yet, but $1 trillion worth of air appears to have escaped
items.summary: Not so much 'going out with a bang' as 'anticlimactic party balloon deflation'.

content.v: Many of tech's heaviest hitters have seen their share prices decrease significantly this week. For instance, Nvidia has seen a decrease of about 8% over the last five days—and this AI company is far from the only one seeing such a dip.

Over the last five days, we've seen share prices fall by 13% for AMD, and nearly 15% for Intel. Looking more broadly across the AI and semiconductor industries, CNBC reports 20 of the most valuable players have shed more than $1 trillion in value as investors sell off stock.
The bigger picture doesn't look any better: over the last five days, Samsung Electronics has seen its share price decrease by nearly 20%, SK hynix is down 18%, and Micron has seen a dip of over 15%.

A combination of factors have likely triggered this big chip stock sell off, including concerns that the memory supply crisis may actually reverse into oversupply come 2029, according to a recent column in South Korea's Maeil Business Newspaper .

There's more going on than just the CEO of Acer insisting " It's impossible for the shortage to last until 2030 !" We also know that many chip manufacturers have already been working to boost their production capacity, though TSMC's next-gen Arizona fab is fully booked before it has even been built .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gZVF2aBShFnje6vinn5PvR-1920-80.jpg

Chinese manufacturer CXMT is also growing, which is likely to go at least some way towards putting a dampener on the western market's aspirations. It's been stocking up on western DUV machines and is estimated to match Micron in terms of DRAM manufacturing capabilities this year . The chip manufacturer also recently claimed it had created breakthrough chip architecture that increases memory density . Make no mistake, CXMT is one to watch.

On top of that, The CEOs of both Intel and Broadcom recently claimed that financing could become a bigger hurdle to overcome for the AI industry than even securing memory or electricity supply. The uptick in interest rates means that investors may feel the balance between borrowing and the return on investment for big tech's data centre build out is looking increasingly lopsided.

So, is the AI bubble finally popping? Even as air is clearly escaping, it's still hard to say. The resulting lower share prices from this widespread stock sell-off may inspire some investors to buy, for one thing.

Despite the high price of these infrastructure projects, the demand for AI computing remains robust according to tech analyst Dan Ives for merchant bank Yorkville Ives. Ives told CNBC, "What would change our view is a demand signal, not [an increased interest] rate signal."
As such, big tech likely won't be ditching data centres any time soon, and the AI bubble may once again reach for something more party-balloon shaped in the future.
